partnership.title: School & Government Partnership
partnership.intro_1: Timedoor Academy opens collaboration opportunities with schools and government institutions to deliver relevant and practical technology education. We provide programming and design programs tailored to curriculum needs and student development activities.
partnership.intro_2: Partnership formats include core subjects, extracurricular programs, technology clubs, teacher training, affiliate programs, and venue partnerships. Each program is designed to sustainably improve digital competencies.
